hooks.name: No Date.now() in Game Core
hooks.description: After a save under src/lib/game, lints that file with the repo ESLint config (haunted/no-wall-clock). The path comes from the {{filePath}} argument, KIRO_FILE_PATH, or stdin JSON event.file_path. A violation is written to stderr and the process exits 1. PostFileSave cannot block the save.
